On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
From 11.45am to 12.45pm, F1 Manly ferries will not run. 
  • Circular Quay: the last ferry leaves at 11.40am; services resume at 12.45pm.
  • Manly: the last ferry leaves 11.15am; services resume at 12:30pm.
  • Catch a bus to travel between Manly and the City while services aren’t running. Additional route 170x services will run between Manly and Wynyard. 
From 7pm to 10pm, F1 Manly ferries will not stop at Circular Quay and will use Barangaroo Wharf instead. 
  • From Manly: The last ferry to Circular Quay leaves at 6.25pm; services leaving from 6.45pm to 9.20pm will end at Barangaroo. Services resume running to Circular Quay from 9.50pm. 
  • To Manly: The last ferry from Circular Quay leaves at 6.50pm; services from 7.10pm to 9.10pm will leave from Barangaroo. Services resume running from Circular Quay at 10.05pm. 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Valla Beach Road diversion – bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 12 January 2026, roadworks at Valla Beach Road will require buses on routes 358, 360 and 360X between Macksville, Coffs Harbour and Bellingen to divert.

The diversion will add time to all buses operating to/from Valla Beach. Some other timetables will also be adjusted due to this diversion.

No bus will depart earlier than its normal time.

The changes are expected to be in place for approximately two weeks.

Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.
 
Bus routes affected:
  • 358 – Macksville to Bellingen via Nambucca Heads & Urunga
  • 360 - Macksville to Park Beach Plaza via Nambucca Heads, Urunga & Toormina
  • 360X - Macksville to Coffs Harbour Park Ave via Nambucca Heads (Express Service)
